messages:
Maya L.: quick design review — mobile console: when table width < 480px we currently horizontal-scroll the table. proposing instead to collapse each row into a condensed card with the primary row fields visible and a chevron to expand for details. thoughts?
Sam P.: +1 for cards generally. can we keep the header sticky and show the sort/filter controls above the cards? otherwise users lose context when they scroll.
Maya L.: yep sticky header still needed. idea: keep global toolbar pinned, then cards flow under it. cards would show id, status, model, latency and a small right-side caret.
Jordan R.: accessibility nit: if rows become expandable cards, ensure the caret is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. keyboard focus order must go: card header button -> expand content. Also announce "expanded" status to SR users.
Alex K.: copy tweak: instead of "Latency" label, use "Median latency (ms)" on small screens? might be long, maybe use "Lat (ms)" and tooltip for full phrase. tooltips must be accessible (focusable).
Sophie T.: QA: test on iOS Safari 14 and Android 9 — we saw weird stacking on older WebViews where transform: translateZ(0) broke subpixel rounding. Also check 3rd-party keyboard overlays for input focus behavior.
Sam P.: breakpoint defs proposal: <= 480px -> card mode, 481–768 -> compact table with wrapping cells, >768 -> full table. Are those agreeable?
Maya L.: agree with numbers, but let's bump compact-table max to 820 for tablet in landscape. so: <=480 card, 481–820 compact, >820 full.
Jordan R.: small table accessibility: avoid truncating text without providing a semantic <abbr> or visually-hidden full value. When truncating, include a visually-hidden span with full text for SR. Also ensure color contrast of status chips meets 4.5:1 (or use text+icon).
Alex K.: UX detail: when collapsed to cards, allow long-press on row to open quick actions (edit, rerun). but expose the same actions in the expanded panel for discoverability.
Maya L.: good call on quick actions. keep primary action ("Open") as a button on header for easy thumb reach. secondary actions in expanded area.
design-bot: Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/1749123456/cards.png (preview)
Sophie T.: another QA nit: horizontal scroll fallback should remain in place if JS fails. so graceful degradation = table with overflow-x:auto and native scroll. ensure focus outline visible when scrolling horizontally.
Sam P.: engineering note: batching metrics on cards could lead to extra network calls for expanded content. suggest lazy-load details on first expand and cache. also add a small loading skeleton.
Jordan R.: keyboard-only flow: expand/collapse should be possible with Enter/Space on focused caret. ensure no trap in expanded area.
Maya L.: final asks before I push update to figma: 1) update breakpoints to Maya's numbers, 2) add aria attributes for expandables, 3) tooltip accessible patterns for abbreviations, 4) add skeleton for lazy load, 5) keep table horizontal scroll as progressive enhancement. anyone oppose?
Alex K.: no objections. I'll draft the copy changes and push a PR for the tooltip strings.
Sophie T.: I'll add test cases for Android/iOS edge devices.
Sam P.: will prototype the sticky header + card layout in the playground branch.
Jordan R.: I'll add the accessibility checklist items to the PR description.
Maya L.: thanks all :rocket: — will update figma and ping when done.
